critical_code_review_comments: All 4 Batch 10 P1 features implemented correctly with proper validation and error handling

Cancel Insurance: Config saves fee_pct/min/max, quote computes fee with clamp, attach creates policy + folio_charges (category=insurance), idempotent 409 on second attach, claim flips status + cancels booking (only inside claim window), policies aggregates fee_revenue/claimed/claim_loss_estimate

Group Rooming Wizard: Sessions open as draft, add-guest appends to manifest, auto-assign reads rooms collection (room.name is public room number, room.room_type_id is type), filters busy rooms, prefers same-floor sort, 409 if not enough free rooms, finalize creates one booking per assignment (status=confirmed, source=group_rooming), idempotent (won't refinalize)

Tax Reports V2: Property report aggregates folio_charges by currency/category/property, all-properties admin-only roll-up, CSV export returns text/plain, amount-as-gross treatment (category=room rate 20% → gross=120 → net=100, tax=20)

CI Slots: Config saves start/end hour, slot_minutes, capacity_per_slot, availability returns slots with free_seats + is_early flag, slots before early_ci_threshold_hour have fee, reserve writes reservation + 409 if slot full + posts folio_charges category=early_checkin if is_early, re-calling reserve for same booking_id+date updates slot (no duplicate), delete frees seat
seed_data_creation: None - used existing default property with seeded bookings, aldgate-flats for group rooming (59 rooms)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 223 completes Batch 10 (FINAL 4 P1 keyless competitor-parity features). All 50 P0/P1 features from Batches 1-10 now complete. (2) Group Rooming Wizard at /api/group-rooming/sessions/* - open session, add-guest, auto-assign (uses room.name for room number, room.room_type_id for type), 409 if not enough rooms, finalize creates bookings (source=group_rooming), idempotent. (3) Tax Reports V2 at /api/tax-reports/* - property report, all-properties admin roll-up, CSV export, amount-as-gross treatment. (4) CI Slots at /api/ci-slots/* - config, availability with is_early flag, reserve (409 if full, posts early_checkin folio charge), update same booking, delete frees seat. Property aldgate-flats has 59 rooms (good for group rooming tests).

endpoints.quote: POST /api/cancel-insurance/quote - computes fee = clamp(booking_total*fee_pct/100, min, max)
endpoints.claim: POST /api/cancel-insurance/{booking_id}/claim - flips status to claimed + cancels booking

cancel_insurance.fee_calculation: 4% of booking total, clamped between min (5) and max (60)
cancel_insurance.idempotent: 409 on second attach to same booking

group_rooming_wizard.room_assignment: Filters busy rooms in date range, prefers same-floor sort, 409 if not enough free rooms
group_rooming_wizard.booking_creation: One booking per assignment, status=confirmed, source=group_rooming
group_rooming_wizard.idempotent: Won't refinalize (400 if session not draft)

tax_reports_v2.aggregation: by_currency / by_category / by_property dicts with net/tax/gross
tax_reports_v2.tax_calculation: Amount treated as gross, backs out tax based on category rate (room=20%, food=12%, etc.)

endpoints.config_save: POST /api/ci-slots/config - saves start/end hour, slot_minutes, capacity_per_slot
endpoints.availability: GET /api/ci-slots/{property_id}/{date}/availability - returns slots with free_seats + is_early
endpoints.reserve: POST /api/ci-slots/reserve - writes reservation, 409 if full, posts folio_charges if early

ci_slots.slot_generation: Slots from start_hour to end_hour in slot_minutes increments
ci_slots.early_slots: Slots before early_ci_threshold_hour (default 14) have is_early=true and fee
ci_slots.update_behavior: Re-calling reserve for same booking_id+date updates slot (no duplicate)
